Each node must sustain a local triangle density above a threshold across its transaction neighbors, measured over rolling epochs, so an attacker's fresh copies land on a shale-like flat region with no shared counterparties. An agent earns its position by sitting on a knoll of dense, mutually transacting peers that take real work to fabricate. The cost is maintaining a mesa of sustained trading volume across many distinct counterparties for the whole audit window, paid per fake identity.
